3139-5315-5660-6769.easyPrerequisites: Evolution Witness has a +1/+1 counter on it.
3139-5315-5660-6769.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 7 or greater.
3139-5315-5660-6769.description:
Cast The Great Henge by paying {G}{G}. 
When The Great Henge enters, Surge Conductor triggers.
Holding priority, activate The Great Henge by tapping it, adding {G}{G} and causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing The Great Henge, giving Ravenous Intruder +2/+2 until end of turn.
Resolve the Surge Conductor trigger, causing you to proliferate, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning The Great Henge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat

4279-4976-6559--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
4279-4976-6559--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Venerated Stormsinger, Open the Graves and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Venerated Stormsinger trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Open the Graves ability, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Venerated Stormsinger triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

3099-3812-6006.easyPrerequisites: Simic Ragworm doesn't have summoning sickness.
3099-3812-6006.description:
Activate Simic Ragworm by tapping it, adding {U}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Simic Ragworm by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.
3099-3812-6006.notes: Once you have infinite green mana, you may activate Leyline of Abundance any number of times, putting infinite +1/+1 counters on creatures you control.

401-883-3944-8125.easyPrerequisites:
You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
Your life total is at least 2.
401-883-3944-8125.description:
Cast Blood Pet by paying {B}.
When Blood Pet enters the battlefield, Davvol triggers, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it, adding {B}.
When Blood Pet dies, Decaying Soil and Ashes of the Abhorrent trigger.
Resolve the Decaying Soil trigger, causing you to pay {1} to return Blood Pet from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Ashes of the Abhorrent trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Repeat.

4687-5115-5268.notablePrerequisites: Gemstone Array has at least four counters on it.
4687-5115-5268.description:
Activate Gilder Bairn using its ability from Utopia Vow by tapping it, adding one mana.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on Gemstone Array.
Activate Gemstone Array as many times as necessary by removing counters from it, adding at least two mana.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite counters on Gemstone Array, you may instead double the counters on any other permanents.

1887-2021-2060-7315.description:
Activate Simic Ascendancy by paying {1}{G}{U}, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting growth counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

751-1362-2653-3314.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying one mana.
Chulane triggers, causing you to draw a card and put Oboro, Palace in the Clouds from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Oboro, Palace in the Clouds enters the battlefield, Nissa triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Oboro's first ability by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Oboro's second ability by paying {1}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, triggering itself, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1619-2921-4605-5542-6151.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-2921-4605-5542-6151.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Underdark Explorer from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Underdark Explorer enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Underdark Explorer.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Underdark Explorer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Underdark Explorer token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Underdark Explorer token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Underdark Explorer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the Underdark Explorer trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-2921-4605-5542-6151.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

360-2034-3490-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
360-2034-3490-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Soul Warden triggers, causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the The Destined White Mage trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

413-2049-7124.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
413-2049-7124.description:
Declare The Incredible Hulk and Ogre Chitterlord as attackers.
Ogre Chitterlord triggers, creating two creature tokens.
When the tokens enter, Blasting Station triggers twice, untapping Blasting Station
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing a creature token, dealing 1 damage to The Incredible Hulk.
The Incredible Hulk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, then untapping it and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

2067-7307.description:
Cast Storm Herd by paying {8}{W}{W}, creating a number of 1/1 Pegasus creature tokens equal to your life total.
When the Pegasi enter, Raphael triggers that many times, dealing that much damage divided among your opponents.

140-4484-4871-5643-6798.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
140-4484-4871-5643-6798.notablePrerequisites: You've lost X or more life this turn.
140-4484-4871-5643-6798.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath.
When the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Umbral Collar Zealot abilities.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
140-4484-4871-5643-6798.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

997-1726-6972.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Scrapyard Recombiner.
When Scrapyard Recombiner dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Scrapyard Recombiner's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Scrapyard Recombiner from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

539-5147-7008.description:
Cast Badgermole Cub by paying its mana cost
When Badgermole Cub enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Badgermole Cub
When Badgermole Cub dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Badgermole Cub enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat from step 3.

3767-3918-4452-7013.description:
Activate Trazyn using White Lotus Tile's ability by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color.
Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat.

2173-3652-5220-5330.description:
Activate Atog by sacrificing Ornithopter
When Ornithopter dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Ornithopter from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Atog ability.
Cast Ornithopter from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

3234-3293-5411-6797.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
3234-3293-5411-6797.description:
Activate Need for Speed by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat
3234-3293-5411-6797.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

1350-4231-5444-6753.description:
Cast Carnage Interpreter by paying {1}{B/R}{B/R}.
When Carnage Interpreter enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating eight Clue, Food and Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate six Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{W}{B/R}{B/R}.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning Carnage Interpreter to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.

2292-3951-4192-5703.notablePrerequisites:
Altaïr does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr.
You have at least one legendary creature card exiled with a memory counter on it.
Ashes of the Fallen on the battlefield with "Assassin" chosen.
2292-3951-4192-5703.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker. Altaïr triggers, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it, and then creating a tapped and attacking token copy of each card you own that is exiled with a memory counter on it.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing another legendary creature token except Éomer.
When the creature dies, Éomer triggers, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat during each combat phase.

575-4674-5686.notablePrerequisites: You have a green card in hand.
575-4674-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Temur Charger.
When Temur Charger dies, Yedora triggers, returning Temur Charger from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Temur Charger by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Temur Charger's morph ability by revealing a green card from your hand, turning Temur Charger face up.
Temur Charger triggers, giving target creature trample until end of turn.
Repeat.

1879-2105-3204-6188.notablePrerequisites:
Fear of Missing Out cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
Mysterious Limousine does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
One of Fear of Missing Out or Combat Celebrant must be on the battlefield, with the other exiled by Mysterious Limousine.
1879-2105-3204-6188.description:
Declare either Fear of Missing Out or Combat Celebrant and Mysterious Limousine as attackers.
Mysterious Limousine and either Fear of Missing Out or Combat Celebrant trigger.
Resolve the Fear of Missing Out or Combat Celebrant trigger, untapping Mysterious Limousine and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Mysterious Limousine trigger, exiling Fear of Missing Out or Combat Celebrant from the battlefield, and then returning Fear of Missing Out or Combat Celebrant from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

144-628-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Ashcloud Phoenix, adding {R}.
When Ashcloud Phoenix dies, it triggers, as well as its undying ability if it does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the first trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down.
Resolve the second trigger, doing nothing.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Ashcloud Phoenix, adding {R}.
When Ashcloud Phoenix dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1017-4067-6110.notablePrerequisites:
Brigone does not have summoning sickness, and has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Wizard Class is level 3.
1017-4067-6110.description:
Activate Brigone by tapping and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to draw a card.
Wizard Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Brigone.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Brigone.
Repeat.

uses.n: Optimus Prime, Hero // Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader

628-2981-5263.description:
Activate Megatog by sacrificing Optimus Prime, Hero.
When Optimus Prime, Hero dies, its second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader.
Activate Megatog by sacrificing Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader.
When Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader dies, Mikaeus triggers, returning Optimus Prime from your graveyard to the battlefield as Optimus Prime, Hero with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve both Megatog abilities from steps 1 and 3, giving it +6/+6 until end of turn.
Repeat.

4667-5149-5200.easyPrerequisites: Power Artifact attached to Sword of the Paruns.
4667-5149-5200.notablePrerequisites:
Elvish Aberration does not have summoning sickness.
Sword of the Paruns attached to Elvish Aberration
4667-5149-5200.description:
Activate Elvish Aberration by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {1}, untapping Elvish Aberration.
Repeat.
4667-5149-5200.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may attach Sword of the Paruns to any other creature(s) to untap them.

293-388-4871-5220.description:
Activate Sanguine Spy by paying {1} and sacrificing Narcomoeba.
When Narcomoeba dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Narcomoeba on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Sanguine Spy ability, causing you to put Narcomoeba into your graveyard from the top of your library.
Narcomoeba triggers, returning itself to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1185-2226-4893.notablePrerequisites: Prize Pig does not have summoning sickness.
1185-2226-4893.description:
Activate Prize Pig by tapping it, adding {W}.
Activate Zacama's third ability by paying {W}, causing you to gain three life.
Prize Pig triggers, putting three ribbon counters on it, then removing all ribbon counters on it and untapping it.
Repeat.

2034-2558-4303-4694-4854.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Sword of the Meek, adding {C}{C}.
Sword of the Meek dies, triggering Slagstone Refinery, creating a tapped Powerstone token that enters the battlefield as a 1/1 creature due to March of the Machines and Chief of the Foundry.
Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield, but not attaching itself to the Powerstone due to Sword of the Meek becoming a creature.
Repeat.

361-2660-2757-4050.notablePrerequisites:
Wheel of Sun and Moon attached to you.
You control at least one basic land.
361-2660-2757-4050.description:
Cast Llanowar Sentinel by paying {2}{G}.
Llanowar Sentinel enters the battlefield, triggering itself.
Holding priority, activate Earthcraft by tapping Llanowar Sentinel, untapping a basic land.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Llanowar Sentinel, adding {G}.
Llanowar Sentinel is put on the bottom of your library instead of your graveyard due to Wheel of Sun and Moon.
Resolve the Llanowar Sentinel trigger from step 2, causing you to pay {1}{G} to search your library for Llanowar Sentinel and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

215-1311-2436-4823.notablePrerequisites:
Marwyn does not have summoning sickness.
Marwyn has a power of at least eight.
215-1311-2436-4823.description:
Activate Marwyn by tapping it, adding at least eight {G}.
Cast Mobilize by paying {G}, untapping all creatures you control.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Timeless Witness from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Timeless Witness by paying {2}{G}{G}.
Timeless Witness enters the battlefield, returning Mobilize from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

3693-4017.notablePrerequisites:
Sunbond attached to Walking Ballista.
Walking Ballista has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
You have a way to give Walking Ballista lifelink.
3693-4017.description:
Give Walking Ballista lifelink.
Activate Walking Ballista's second ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain 1 life.
Walking Ballista triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Repeat from step 2.

1987-2427-2493-4792.description:
Activate Paradise Plume by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Paradise Plume and Archaeomancer, blinking them as well as triggering Paradise Plume to gain you 1 life.
When Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Paradise Plume enters the battlefield, choose "blue".
Repeat.
